187: void Logger::run() {
188:     while (true) {
189:         std::queue<LogEntry> local_queue;
190: 
191:         {
192:             std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(this->mutex);
193:             this->condition.wait(
194:                 lock, [this] { return this->stop || !this->queue.empty(); });
195: 
196:             if (this->stop && this->queue.empty()) {
197:                 return;
198:             }
199: 
200:             local_queue.swap(this->queue);
201:         }
202: 
203:         while (!local_queue.empty()) {
204:             const auto& entry = local_queue.front();
205:             auto now = std::chrono::system_clock::now();
206:             std::string date = Logger::date_string(now);
207:             this->rotate_if_needed(date);
208: 
209:             if (this->output.is_open()) {
210:                 this->output << Logger::timestamp_string(now) << " ["
211:                              << Logger::level_name(entry.level)
212:                              << "]: " << entry.message << '\n';
213:                 ++this->current_line_count;
214:             }
215:             local_queue.pop();

222: void Logger::rotate_if_needed(const std::string& date) {
223:     if (this->current_date != date) {
224:         if (this->output.is_open()) {
225:             this->output.close();
226:         }
227: 
228:         this->current_date = date;
229:         this->current_file_index = 0;
230:         this->current_line_count = 0;
231:         this->open_output(date, this->current_file_index);
232:         return;
233:     }
234: 
235:     if (!this->output.is_open()) {
236:         this->open_output(date, this->current_file_index);
237:         return;
238:     }
239: 
240:     if (this->current_line_count >= this->max_lines_per_file) {
241:         this->output.close();
242:         ++this->current_file_index;
243:         this->current_line_count = 0;
244:         this->open_output(date, this->current_file_index);
245:     }
246: }

248: void Logger::open_output(const std::string& date, std::size_t file_index) {
249:     namespace fs = std::filesystem;
250: 
251:     std::error_code error;
252:     fs::path date_dir = fs::path(this->base_path) / date;
253:     fs::create_directories(date_dir, error);
254:     if (error) {
255:         return;
256:     }
257: 
258:     fs::path file_path;
259:     std::size_t index = file_index;
260:     while (true) {
261:         file_path = date_dir / (std::to_string(index) + ".log");
262:         error.clear();
263:         if (!fs::exists(file_path, error) || error) {
264:             break;
265:         }
266:         ++index;
267:     }
268: 
269:     this->current_file_index = index;
270:     this->output.open(file_path, std::ios::app);
271: }
